record_scope_support.layer: OOS has priority in layer label; is_oos and is_doorway both retained so overlapping flags are not lost; non_oos_non_doorway includes special uses and does not certify ordinary scene
record_scope_support.relation: same_target / different_target for two known exact identities; missing_identity if either absent; not a semantic boundary equivalence test
record_scope_support.reference_full_available: Primary record flag; not automatically derived from legacy top_boundary_pending
record_scope_support.payload_full_available: Reference evidence flag; blank for unavailable payload rather than false
record_scope_support.quality_usable: Inherited only; no restoration when full reference exists
record_scope_support.legacy_top_boundary_pending: Historical difficulty metadata, not a current reference gate; unknown preserved

scope_compatibility.rows: Group by layer, doorway flag, condition, target relation, inherited quality use and both full-reference flags
scope_compatibility.counts: Record counts partition inventory; image counts can overlap across groups and are not summed as a new image denominator

image_scope_support.target_full_status: Current target observed in inventory: available / unavailable / mixed / unknown; not_bound_in_inventory when no same-target record
image_scope_support.assigned_reference_count: Distinct nonmissing reference_id observed on this image; different target is not automatically an error
image_scope_support.current_target_quality_records: Count of inherited quality_usable among exact same-target records; complete reference is necessary but not sufficient
image_scope_support.legacy_top_boundary_pending: Only explicit true is counted in the historical 41-image panel; not a fresh ceiling judgement

majority_support.fixed6_simplification: Same ordinary Manual fixed-6 panel as original analysis; direction counts use image's person simplification fraction minus 0.5; positive means more than half simplified
majority_support.highQ_common_speed: Saved highQ 4F1S-minus-5S within-image mean Q difference across original member draws; negative means loss
majority_support.images_observed: Nonmissing image outcomes only; missing never classified nonnegative or zero
majority_support.median_original_value: Original per-image simplification fraction or Q difference median, not building-equal mean
majority_support.inferential_boundary: Direction counts and image/building equal averages answer different questions; repeated members and draws are not independent populations

archive.preserved: Two fixed named missing difficulty CSVs compressed without changing bytes; five existing topic members compared byte-for-byte and not duplicated
archive.identity: ZIP member names and byte lengths, no file hashing, no Downloads path exposed in report/index
archive.adoption: Archived original summaries keep original supports; history pair source has five pairs per panel but actual replacement result uses only the four replaced pairs

unchanged: No forced score for missing/OOS cases
No new classification or difficulty total score
verification: Two pure boundary tests plus current-source denominator and archive byte equality checks; no all-team fusion or all-library rerun
